---
name: Knowledge Base
description: Establish and maintain a GitHub Pages-ready application knowledge base in docs/.
---

# Knowledge Base

Keep all documentation source in `docs/`. Start with an audience and ownership
assessment, then cover setup, architecture, use, API reference, maintenance,
release/deployment, operations, and handover readiness. Prefer Hugo for a
GitHub Pages site unless another static generator is requested.

Generate endpoint documentation from OpenAPI when present. Include safe,
copyable examples and an interactive API experience where appropriate. Keep
the site concise, versioned with the application, accessible, and free of
secrets. Explain how future maintainers update and publish it.
